Printed edition: Tales from the Arabic of the Breslau and Calcutta (1814-18) editions of the book of the thousand nights and one night not occurring in the other printed texts of the work now first done into English, London : Athenasum Publishing Co., 1901, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/talesfromarabico11payn.
